snapshots.changed: The biggest positive change is that the customer activation/provisioning stack and Gatekeeper trigger path are now materially more complete and live-proven, including a real PR webhook review cycle and PR #32 merging. The forecast for business proof is still capped by the unchanged fact that Stromation publicly reports no customers yet and has no proven recurring revenue.

snapshots.changed: The biggest change is that fresh live engineering sessions finally exercised the department/worker architecture deeply enough to expose real routing, grant, and completion-evidence defects, and those defects were repaired on main. This materially increases confidence in autonomous operations, while business proof remains constrained because the public site still reports no paying customers.
snapshots.method: Independent estimate grounded in current main-branch implementation state, recent merged fixes from live autonomous sessions, Gatekeeper-reviewed site work, the live commercial offer and checkout surface, venture activity, and explicit public customer/revenue evidence. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.

snapshots.changed: The biggest change is operational simplification: Gatekeeper was reduced from a costly, churn-prone AI copy critic to a deterministic publish-safety/CI gate with retryable HOLD semantics, while live-run defects around Bash mutation, false-failure permits, worker completion truth, and blocker delivery were repaired. This raises technical and autonomy confidence, but the Day-90 revenue range is more conservative because there is still no paying-customer evidence or proven acquisition channel despite new SEO/resource pages.
snapshots.method: Independent estimate grounded in current main-branch implementation state, recent autonomous-run defect repairs, the simplified publish-safety gate, current fulfillment/billing capability truth, live site/offer evidence, active venture updates, and explicit customer/revenue evidence. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.

snapshots.changed: The biggest change is that the venture lab gained a real evidence-and-economics layer: attributed revenue/direct cost, measured behavior and retention, pre-declared success criteria, and fail-closed advancement gates now exist on main. Routing, branch delivery, and stale self-exec authority defects were also repaired, and new resource pages shipped. This raises technical, autonomy, and commercial confidence, but business proof moves only slightly because Stromation still publicly reports no customers and there is still no proven repeatable acquisition channel or verified venture revenue/PMF.
snapshots.method: Independent estimate grounded in the current main-branch implementation, recent autonomous-run and authority/delivery defect repairs, new venture economics/behavior/experiment infrastructure, fresh site/resource and scheduled venture updates, the live commercial offer, and explicit customer/revenue evidence. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.

snapshots.changed: The biggest change is that heavy real production use exposed and then closed several autonomy defects in the actual worker delivery path: shared-checkout collisions, stale/reused branch ambiguity, rework target misrouting, missing governed PR creation, lossy objective-to-worker requirements, and site-style drift. The repaired system now serializes Builder git work, governs PR creation, carries objective specs verbatim, enforces fresh-vs-continuation branch intent, and applies one site contract, while automated venture price capture continues. This raises technical, autonomy, and commercial confidence modestly, but business proof does not move because the live site still says no customers yet and there is no verified venture revenue or repeatable acquisition channel.
snapshots.method: Independent estimate grounded in current main-branch implementation, the Aug. 24-25 production incident/fix cycle, recent merged autonomous site deliveries and guardrails, continued scheduled LLM Cost Tracker operation, the live founding-pilot and custom offers, and explicit customer/revenue evidence. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.

snapshots.changed: The biggest change is the two-executive production split: Sol now owns COMPANY/CUSTOMER while a persistent Venture Operator owns VENTURE, but the first live post-split sessions immediately exposed budget-envelope query, zero-budget launch, accounting-source, and routing-phrasing failures before those defects were repaired. That is stronger architecture but weaker demonstrated operational reliability than yesterday, so current autonomy is marked down. At the same time the venture system used its evidence discipline to kill LLM Cost Tracker while preserving daily data capture, which is modest real business-process proof even though the public site still reports no customers and no recurring revenue.
snapshots.method: Independent estimate grounded in current main-branch implementation, the merged two-orchestrator architecture and its first production incident/fix cycle, recent autonomous worker site deliveries, venture kill-and-refill policy evidence, continued scheduled data capture, the live founding-pilot/custom offers, and explicit public customer/revenue evidence. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.

snapshots.changed: The biggest change is the production model-routing migration: a live multi-cloud tournament completed 48 graded runs and Gemini 3.7 Flash was promoted to primary Builder on Vertex, but the first two real queued Builder jobs then exposed two separate production-only integration defects (catalog tier recognition and drained-row contract loss) before any model spend. Both were repaired quickly and fail-closed behavior prevented bad spend, but the new path is not yet end-to-end proven on real Builder work, so technical maturity rises while current autonomy falls. Commercial surfaces improved modestly, but the public site still explicitly reports no customers and the previously live LLM Cost Tracker venture has been killed on evidence, leaving business proof essentially flat to slightly lower.
snapshots.method: Independent estimate grounded in current main-branch implementation, the 48-run multi-cloud model tournament and merged routing policy, first real Gemini Builder production failures and repairs, current public offer/site state, venture kill evidence, and explicit customer/revenue evidence. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.

snapshots.changed: The biggest change is that the resumed venture tournament exposed a broader reliability gap than yesterday's forecast assumed: repeated live failures around research-pack completion, search spirals, pre-funding target identity, same-family challenge routing, stale evidence epochs, browser-capability false positives, and candidate/evidence identity all required new deterministic fixes. The repairs are strong and the test battery reached 2387 passed, but current autonomy is marked down because those defects appeared in normal operation. Commercial readiness also falls because the public site still says LLM Cost Tracker is live even though the venture was killed on evidence, while it still explicitly reports no customers.
snapshots.method: Independent estimate grounded in latest main-branch production fixes and tests, the Aug. 27-28 hardening and resumed tournament runs, autonomous site PR delivery, current live offer/site truth, venture kill/tournament evidence, and explicit customer/revenue evidence. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.

snapshots.changed: The biggest change is that the venture tournament moved from isolated scoring to a real relative-capital-allocation system and then survived live Round 10 use: it produced the first real comparison/defer path, exposed defects in evidence extraction, decision recording, provider budgets, Reddit research pacing, and validator semantics, and those failure classes were repaired while the suite grew to 2633 passed / 1 skipped. That improves current autonomy and commercial execution confidence versus yesterday, but not enough to claim mature autonomy because normal operation is still surfacing production-only defects. Business proof remains flat because the live site still explicitly says no customers and still presents LLM Cost Tracker as live despite repository evidence that it was killed earlier.
snapshots.method: Independent estimate grounded in the latest main-branch relative-tournament implementation, Aug. 28-29 live Round 10 incidents and repairs, build-path and security hardening, restored unsupervised pacing, current live offer/site truth, and explicit customer/revenue evidence. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
